summary: @ZipperHost @wihknown is controlled by our Open Collective and shepherded by @mapkyca and @benwerd. We talked about updating the cPanel Installatron plugin at our last Collective meet up, but need someone with a bit more cPanel/Installatron experience to help.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @ZipperHost @wihknown is controlled by our Open Collective and shepherded by @mapkyca and @benwerd. We talked about updating the cPanel Installatron plugin at our last Collective meet up, but need someone with a bit more cPanel/Installatron experience to help.
